svg.text: Each student owns one frontend, one backend/API and one database. The AI services are shared and run on the PC, outside Docker.
Docker Compose: integrated application (one set per student)
Shared local AI services (non-containerised, reached via host.docker.internal)
Local LLM used by every feature's agentic loop and by the agents below
tools/list, tools/call · one read-only tool set per student, calling that student's API
Retrieves matching sections from 7 policy documents → grounded answer, citations, confidence
Workflow history + audit log (logs/history, logs/audit.jsonl) · also runnable from the terminal (cli.py)
Release 1 modes: AI, MCP, RAG · Release 2 review modes: Multi-Agent, Testing, Cloud Deployment
Release 2 Multi-Agent flow (example: Student 3 "Review with agents")
Backend also checks the Worker's answer against the catalog and flags made-up product IDs before the human decides.
If the Multi-Agent Server or Ollama is down, the panel shows a clear message and the rest of the feature keeps working.
① HTTP/HTMX ② SQL CRUD ③ AI-Mode prompt ④ MCP tools/call ⑤ RAG query ⑥ Multi-Agent workflow
